findings.message: 1 line in "While it lasts" has no quote from the guideline ("When to roll them onto their side. The sources differ:"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
1 line in "Epilepsy with a plan" has no quote from the guideline ("When to call 111 differs:"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
2 lines in "Not waking up" have no quote from the guideline ("Call 111 if they stay unresponsive. The time differs:"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
2 lines in "Hand over" have no quote from the guideline ("Tell the ambulance or doctor: when it started and stopped…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
The guideline mentions 2 amounts the template never uses: 3 %, 2 minute. Some may be background; check none were left out.
Nobody is named under "Reviewed by:", so the app shows "Not reviewed".
The saved guideline text is a web copy made by a fetch tool and may not be word-perfect, so a "quote not found" may be the copy's fault. Add the PDF to sources/ for exact checking.
